title: Dynamic Tool Swap
description: Automatically equips the right tool when you start mining — no more manual switching!
body:
Dynamic Tool Swap **automatically** switches to the best tool in your hotbar when you **look** at a **block** or **mob** — no more **manually** swapping between your pickaxe, axe, and sword mid-fight or while mining. Just look and let the mod do the work.
Features:

**Automatic** tool switching based on what you're looking at
Works with all vanilla tools
**Lightweight** and **client-side** only — no server installation needed

Perfect for players who want a smoother, more efficient gameplay experience without breaking immersion.
_P.S. Sorry for only one minecraft version - kondzii14_
